entries.6ff0263953635ba5: It is pursuing the management plan ‘artience2027/2030 “GROWTH”,’ with 2030 as its goal. For the 3 years from 2024 (artience2027), its 3 basic policies are transformation into a group of high-earning existing businesses, creation of a group of strategic key businesses, and transformation of the management foundation. It states that it will concentrate group resources on 2 areas: the mobility and battery field, including lithium-ion battery materials, and the display and advanced electronics field, including color resists for liquid crystal displays, optical pressure-sensitive adhesives and semiconductor-related materials.
